description: This file defines the `PolicyIdModified` event class which represents an event emitted after a Thing's policy ID has been modified. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and accessing event data.

classes.name: PolicyIdModified
classes.description: Represents an event indicating that a Thing's policy ID was modified. This class provides factory methods, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for event data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyIdModified event with specified parameters.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PolicyIdModified instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getPolicyId
methods.description: Returns the modified policy ID as a String (deprecated).

methods.name: getPolicyEntityId
methods.description: Returns the modified policy ID as a PolicyId object.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified DittoHeaders.
